notes.title: Malachite Beetles
notes.content:
A dazzling invasion of Malachite Beetles has blinded Elinor’s citizens with its brilliance, and brought rewards for all bug collectors!

To assemble a Malachite Beetle, you’ll need to get its parts in the following ways:
- 10 coils of gold wire, which is dropped with a chance when defeating experienced monsters
- 10 golden beads – multiple beads can drop at once when defeating a valiant opponent
- ornamental malachite can be found among the rewards from bosses dwelling in dangerous territories
- Master’s Pliers are available in the city stores

Once you’ve assembled beetles, you can exchange them for rewards of your choice, including new additions:
- Normal Participant Token, which grants +1 point to the "Technomagic Competition" ranking or +2 to the Assistant ranking. Normal Token can be upgraded to a Legendary Token for even more ranking points!
- Normal Warrior Cube, which grants Rubidium Plates. Upgrading the Cube to the Enchanted one will bring you a choice between a low-capacity battery and the Rubidium Plates. Magical Cube will let you choose Order of Glory, Heroic Cube – Clot of the battle rage, Epic Cube – Threads of Fate. Each upgrade increases the quantity of resources received.
Low-capacity batteries can be combined to form medium-capacity batteries, and then into high-capacity ones.

Every time you receive a reward from a Malachite Beetle, you also get a chance to receive a rare inlay stone - Adamas of Power  as a bonus reward!

Elinor Bank is enchanted by the charm of Malachite Beetles and will gift you 4 Malachite Beetles for every 100 crystals in a single payment!

You can collect beetle parts and assemble full Malachite Beetles until the end of May 25th. Exchanges for rewards will remain available until the beetles’ lifespan ends.

New Feature: Communicating with the Administration about bugs and issues is now easier. 
The “Problems” section in the Other Functions window has been updated — now you can see your submitted messages and the Admin’s replies directly in the window.

Hurry up to become a proud Malachite Collector!

notes.title: Victory Day is Coming Soon
notes.content:
The residents of Elinor have begun preparations for the celebration, offering you themed quests and gifts, the rescue of imprisoned souls in the Dark Vaults, in-game events, discounts, rare item sales, and new pouches with fragments of Platums of Resistance and Evil Eye!

Sh'aktayn is calling upon all warriors to help free the imprisoned souls. He will be giving you 3 Shadow Dust daily for liberating 1 to 5 souls upon victory in the Dark Vaults. You can purchase unlimited Shadow Dust from the Sales Representative on the Island of Initiation. For detailed information, check the Quest log.
Soul rescue is available until the end of May 20th, and you can claim rewards until May 21st inclusive.

Until May 11th, be sure to:
- Visit the Headman or the Elder to complete the quests “Great Warriors of the Past” and “Preparations for Victory Day”.
- Buy charming bouquets and themed gifts from the city Florists.
- Enjoy 30% discounts on: Aura Translators at the Artifact Store, Crystal Skin Amplifiers in the Artifact Hall, Enchanted Ink Barrels in the Crystal Store, Sleeping Mihrutkas and Peaceful Protectresses in the Artifact Store and Supply Center.
- Stock up on Skin Artifact workpieces and Blue Crystals at the Rarity Store.
- Purchase Life-giving Ichor, Level Change Certificates, and a limited batch of Boss Summoning Items in the Crystal Store.

In the coming days festive promotions await you!
From the moment this news is published until the end of the day, possessing Crystal Balls will grant triple Hate Charges.
On May 8th, every victory in the Dark Vaults brings an extra Box of Light or Darkness, depending on your chosen path.
On May 9th, (Victory Day) two special bonuses await you during the day! Defeat will not reduce your armor durability. Victories in the Dark Vaults will free twice as many souls, provided you have the necessary amount of Shadow Dust.
On May 10th, killing an equal enemy will grant triple points toward medals for killing with a spell, using a spell or triggering a passive effect.
On May 11th, defeating valiant opponents will award double the amount of "Skills" collection elements.

A new item has appeared on the City Store shelves — pouches with fragments of Platums of Resistance and Evil Eye, plus the option to exchange lower-color fragments for higher ones.

Happy upcoming Victory Day!

notes.title: The Seventeenth Technomagiversary!
Defender’s Day is Coming
notes.content:
As the holiday approaches, entertainment events, game promotions, and discounts have appeared in Elinor, along with statues of the First Black Knight and the Bounty Hunter in the squares of Longholm and Khatog.

Upon entering the game, you will be notified about the installation of the statues of the First Black Knight and the Bounty Hunter in the central squares. Until the end of February, you can make offerings of military insignias and receive rewards for showing honor.
By visiting Gaslan or Nadum, you will find festive quests: "Glorious Combat Traditions" and "Stolen Relics." Quest-related items can also be purchased from trade representatives near the Colosseum.
The quests will be available until February 25th, inclusive.

The Servant of Darkness, Sh'aktayn, has taken an interest in your combat abilities and calls upon you to participate in freeing imprisoned souls!
When visiting the Dark Vaults, you need to have shadow dust with you. By emerging victorious in the Dark Vaults, you will receive 1 to 5 souls at the cost of some dust. Each day throughout the event, Sh'aktayn will grant you 3 pieces of dust, and you can purchase an unlimited amount from the Sales Representative on the Island of Initiation.
The soul liberation event will end on March 6th, and rewards can be claimed until the end of March 7th.

Take some time to go on a search for ancient mechanisms! Hilgor and Virkli will offer you one of five quests at random each day. Completing them will earn you Ancient Tokens and Grimbold Coins, which are required for acquiring items in the Supply Center that help unlock various medals. For a certain fee, you can remove the quest timer, with the cost increasing each time but resetting at midnight.
By using the "Notes on the Ancients," you can cancel an unwanted quest and receive a new one under general conditions.
The ancient mechanism search quests will be available until March 2nd inclusive, while rewards and item purchases can be made until the end of March 3rd.

You can find a more detailed description of all the events mentioned in the quest log.

This weekend you can enjoy game promotions and discounts:  
- On February 21st, victories in the Dark Vaults will free twice as many imprisoned souls when shadow dust is used.  
- On February 22nd, your armor will retain its durability upon defeat.  
- On February 23rd, "Paratrooper" will be available without an obsidian fee or an attack order.

Until the end of February 23rd, you’ll get a 30% discount on exchanging and crafting character equipment in the in-game forge. The cost of the first removal of the Ancient quest timer is reduced to 25 Personalized Coins, while each subsequent removal will increase in cost by 25 Personalized Coins.

Brave gifts and the "Festive Grenade" firecracker for courageous defenders can be found at the city florists' stalls!

And, of course, gifts from the Elinor Bank! By replenishing your account before the end of February 27th, for every 300 crystals from a single payment, you will receive one Ancient Chest containing items for the "Ancient Mechanisms" event!

Happy holiday, dear Defenders!

notes.title: Purification of the dark ether
notes.content:
A new week will delight you with the purification of the light-bearing ether and lottery tickets from the Bank of Elinor.
After visiting the town alchemist and herbalist, you will learn how to proceed to purify the ether with aquaionite, which can be obtained in several ways:
- a small amount daily from Valian or Kimihla, with a chance when searching the wells of Soli-Dor and in exchange for universal coins from the Cryptographer;
- defeating skilled monsters of hazardous territories if you have a retort, which is available from the merchant nearby the Colosseum;
- by purchasing them from the Artifact Store.

Purification of the ether is accomplished in several stages, and you can stop at each stage to obtain the specified reward. Purchasing the subsequent dark aether from the Rarity Store will become available after you receive the current progress reward.
Note that once you receive the reward before the end of the event, you will not be able to mine aquaionite until you receive the Aether Purification quest again.
Getting aquaionite is available up to and including November 22, while purifying the ether and selecting an award can be done at any time. 

And once again, there are gifts from the Bank of Elinor waiting for you! For each 1000 crystals from the amount of one payment till the end of November 19 you will receive 1 lottery ticket of draw #6! When you open the ticket, you will get one of the prizes: a set of calligraphic symbols, a casket with strong arBrillmagrams, one of the calligraphic symbols, an enchanted barrel with ink, or 100 crystals!

We wish you a great week!

notes.title: Yar Marco’s Sale
notes.content:
Elinor’s town squares are bustling with excitement as Yar Marco hosts a spectacular autumn sale on a wide range of goods!
During this festive market week,  discounts from Yar Marco’s assistant and the speculator await you:
- 40% off items categorized as “Ammunition,” “Bonus,” “Weapons,” and “Jewelry.”
- 20–40% off alchemical cauldrons of life, magic, and hate; Ghostly cards of Darkness and Light; cards of magic, desert dweller, shadow-binder and twilight warden cards; ancient human and dwarf skins; small flasks of denial; copying sheets; gladiator standards; ghost boxes, and more.

Additionally, you have a unique opportunity to purchase previously unavailable medals from the lines “Pumpkin Mayhem,” “Egg Champion,” “Farewell to Winter,” and “Love spell datura.”

Please note! Activating the ghost boxes now requires payment in silver hunter coins.

And there’s more! Twilight Warriors (for humans) and Twilight Knights (for dwarves) now offer ongoing challenges in the Dark Vaults. Each player can summon them 5 times per day. Additional combats with Twilight battlers can be purchased once these 5 attempts are used.

Along with regular trophies, victories in the Dark Vaults now yield a chance to obtain one of the cards from a new deck: twilight warden, necromancer, cursed, nightbringer, or renegade. A full set of these cards can be combined into a normal twilight joker, allowing you to summon a warrior every two days. Two normal jokers can be assembled into an enchanted joker, which allows summoning once per day, and a legendary joker allows up to 5 daily summons.
Three identical cards can be exchanged for a random one or obtained from a twilight ghostly card, now added to the ghostly box. Yar Marco’s assistant will happily exchange extra twilight warden cards, and a limited supply of ghostly twilight cards is available from the speculator.

For warriors of level 24 and above: Medals in the “Mighty Giant” line are now available for using legendary giant elixirs. Requirements have increased for the “Mighty Giant II” and “Mighty Giant IV” medals, while the requirement for “Mighty Giant V” has been reduced. Players with existing medals have been credited for any shortfalls to meet the new criteria. 
Medal prices have also been significantly reduced.
The appearance of medals in this and other medal lines with rare ammunition has been updated.

Visit Yar Marco before the discounts end!

notes.title: Autumn Blues
notes.content:
As autumn sets in, Elinor’s sweethearts, Laura and Miella, have been feeling a bit down. Only your thoughtful attention and summer-inspired gifts can lift their spirits!

Terrus or Terragorcan can help you out to deal with Laura's and Miella's sadness by sharing a secret of what kind of delightful gifts might cheer up those knowledge seekers. 
Preparing a gift requires the following conditions:
- time for making one gift is 4 hours;
- a gift may contain no more than 10 items.
- The total "mood points" in each gift should be at least 100.
After talking with Laura or Miella, you’ll find a list of gift items and how to obtain them in your quest log. You can only give a gift every 12 hours, but you can reset this cooldown for a small fee in personalized coins and by resetting the quest progress, start gathering a new gift.

When the ladies receive a gift, they will reward you with a Happy Autumn Chest. Opening the chest will give you:
- 2–4 Vials with a ray of sun,
- 20 Suns,
- 100 Tauri,
- 5 Gladiator coins.

Vials with the ray of Sun can be exchanged for rewards of your choice:
- 1 vial for 10 Magnecharges (from level 7),
- 10 vials for 10 life-giving ichors or Magical Boots of speed (from level 7),
- 20 vials for 2 Crystal Keys or 5 Technowarrior Chests,
- 50 vials for 3 Leader Chests, a Ghostly Box, or 4 Fragile Horns of Plenty,
- 100 vials for 25 Autumn Surprise Boxes, a Personal Card Box (one-time only), or 250 fragments of the Fractal Matrix  (from level 11),
- 150 vials for 3 Hearts of the Forest Spirit (from level 7, one-time only) or 3 Fullerite Hearts,
- 200 vials for 2000 Legendary Magic Storages or a Sealed Symbol (one-time only).

Concerned for the scholars’ gloomy mood, the Bank of Elinor is also giving gifts to its depositors! Until November 10th, for every 100 crystals from the amount of one payment, you will receive one Swimming circle granting 60 mood points.

You can prepare and send gifts until November 15th, and open chests and exchange Vials with a ray of sun until the end of autumn.

May this help you overcome the autumn blues!

notes.title: Dungeon Scouts
notes.content:
Valiant warriors and fearless fighters! After completing training with the desert scouts, highly skilled warriors of the underground world have come forth.  
Having displaced the previously dwelling Mad Warriors, new scouts - shadow warriors have now appeared in the dungeons and catacombs of Soli-Dor. These warriors are similar to the desert scouts in many ways but possess their own unique abilities.  
Please note that none of your pets or companions will be able to respond to a call for help during a battle with shadow warriors.  
Daily you can defeat up to 5 shadow warriors in each territory. In case of defeat, you have 2 hours to return and face the experienced opponent again. After the time runs out or upon victory, the warrior will return to his base and reappear only the next day.  
By defeating shadow warriors, you will receive all the expected trophies, just as you would for defeating an opponent in the catacombs or dungeons of Soli-Dor.  
In addition to the usual trophies, there is a chance to find cards of the underground inhabitants — shadow binder, cavemen, catacomb dwellers, draconoids, and reptiloids. 
A full set of cards can be combined into a normal shadow binder joker, which allows you to summon such warrior for battle once every 2 days. Two normal jokers can be combined into an enchanted one using a card box, allowing you to summon the warrior once per day, and by collecting a legendary joker, you can summon the warrior up to 5 times a day.  
You can exchange three similar cards for one random card, or obtain it from the ghostly shadow binder card, which has been added to the ghostly box.

Exchange Improvements

The Exchange has gained additional features:
- You can now specify if a request requires a full buyout, meaning it cannot be partially fulfilled, only in full.
- A new filter “available in stock” has been added to the request list, which shows only the requests for which you have at least 1 of the required items available.
- A search icon (magnifying glass) has been added to the bottom right corner of the item's image in a request. Clicking on it will display only the requests that require that particular item.

Starting October 2nd, mk3 and mk4 set weapons will be bound to their respective classes, meaning you will need the appropriate destiny sign to equip them.

We wish you success in your battles!

notes.title: The Fair Train has Arrived
notes.content:
Valiant technomages and technomagesses! Yar Marko and his assistants have arrived right on time and have already set up their goods, awaiting your visit!

On the stalls of Yar Marko’s assistant and the Speculator, you will find goods to suit every taste: for the masters, there’s the experience of a master craftsman and pro tools, for hunters - the magic scroll of luck, gold tablet, a cage with mice or bloodsuckers, and a limited supply of boss summons, for warriors - diamond dust, elixirs of the gods, ghost boxes, and gladiator standards, and for the adepts of Darkness and Light, discounted packs of myhryutkas and protectresses as well as rare patterns of fate sketches are prepared! 
Hurry up and get the items you need before the fair ends on 18.09.2024 at 08:00!

The Exchange is Ready for Business!

Shopping has now become much more convenient! Instead of constantly monitoring the Auction or shouting in the trading chat, you can now leave a request for the desired item on the Exchange and wait for sellers to supply it!

The Exchange is available in the Auction building in the corresponding tab. The difference between the Exchange and the Auction is that on the Exchange, buyers leave their requests, and sellers fulfill them.

To create a request for the desired item in the New Request section, you can search by name, color, or type of item. You can post no more than 5 requests at a time. For each request, a tax must be paid under the same conditions as sellers on the auction - from 2% to 9% depending on the lifetime of the request, the item's listed price, considering the quantity of the item in the request. Additionally, the necessary amount to cover your entire request will be reserved from your funds. If the request is not fulfilled or partially fulfilled, the corresponding part of the reserved amount will be returned to you via mail. 
Please note that taxes are non-refundable. 
You can post your request anonymously, and for a small amount of gold, you can also raise your request to the top of the pages - all such requests will be sorted by their remaining lifetime. 
A seller may fulfill a request in full or in part, receiving the due payment via mail. In this case, they will also pay a tax of 8% of the deal's value.

On the Exchange, you can leave requests for equipment, resources, collections, cards, and other items. Only tradable items with a gold value are available. Items sold in the shop are mostly excluded from being requested. Over time, all shop items will be excluded from the Exchange.

For certain items, their type has been changed. For instance, ingredients dropped from monsters and bosses are now classified as Resources, while various ring cutters and Kuskodery have been reclassified as Pliers. Additionally, for items classified as Charms and sold in the shop, a type change is planned.

Sellers of equipment on the Exchange should take note that equipment can only be sold if it meets the following requirements:
 • has full maximum durability;
 • current durability equals maximum durability;
 • does not contain charms, stones, runes, or enhancements;
 • is marked as transferable. 
If the equipment does not meet these requirements, it cannot be sold through a request on the Exchange.

We look forward to your feedback and suggestions for improving the Exchange in this thread.

Desert Warriors Changes 
Depletion was not working against desert warriors when players used power scrolls, giant elixirs, and similar ammunition – this issue has been resolved.

An incorrect combat log entry regarding health restoration in desert dwellers when using power scrolls, giant elixirs, and similar ammunition is now fixed.

The chance to apply a debuff using the shadow flail has been reduced from 5% to 4%.

We wish you pleasant gameplay!

notes.title: Back to School
notes.content:
Very soon we will hear the first bell ringing, marking the start of a new school year. It's time for the children to return to their long-awaited studies! Elinorians can also embark on their educational journey by taking exams in power and intelligence.

Technomages of level 5 and above can start with the preparatory sessions, consisting of "Preparing for School" and "Training materials" quests (if not done previously). After completing these, Technomages of level 6 and above can attempt the "Elinor Knowledge Exam." Exam tickets can be obtained through daily quests, upon daily game login, or purchased in the Crystal Store.

Victory over experienced monsters may yield "grades" (Two, Three, Four, and Five), which can be exchanged for silver coins based on the grade's value.

New avatars for the WMI and AMI Adept (depending on the character's race) are available in the Rarity Store. Owners of the WMI and AMI Listener avatars can upgrade to Adept for free by contacting moders@tmgame.ru for a replacement.
The events are available until September 5th inclusive. 

And of course, there are special offers and discounts during the holidays!
- Armor will retain its durability if defeated until the end of the day.
- On August 31st, defeating experienced monsters and valiant opponents may also yield Suns along with other trophies, redeemable for items in Julian's Store.
- On September 1st, town's headman and the elder will grant you either the effect of Denial or Omniscience.

Additionally, until the end of Sunday, the Elinor Forge offers a 30% discount on equipment exchanges and creations (including creation with exchange), and a 25% discount on account purchases and crystal enhancers for personalized coins in the Artifact Hall.

Happy upcoming Knowledge Day!

notes.title: Certificates with gifts and more
notes.content:
Valiant Technomages! By purchasing crystals before the end of the month, you'll have the opportunity to receive certificates for generous gifts, as well as lucky tickets and barrels of denial.

Until the end of summer, you can earn certificates for special gifts, but for that you'll need to:
1. Make a one-time payment of at least 50 crystals to receive 30 personalizes coins and one of five certificates at random as a gift. Personalized coins will only be awarded with your first payment during the promotion.
2. Complete the task specified on the certificate to receive a gift and another certificate.
3. If you don't like the certificate you received, you can exchange it for another one for 30 personalized coins and get one of the four remaining certificates.

By fulfilling the event conditions, you can obtain a certificate for the Tech Warrior Chest, the Chest of a famous technomage, the Rich Man's Chest, a Card Set, and a Cage with mice or bloodsuckers with a lifespan of 365 days.

With your first payment under the Card Set certificate, you will receive not only a ghostly box but also a card box or one random Scrubb Card. 
Subsequent payments under the same certificate will bring you either a ghostly box (with a high chance) or a card box or a random Scrubb Card.

Until September 3rd, by defeating valiant opponents, you may find Lucky Tickets among other trophies. Opening these tickets will grant you one of the following prizes: gold nuggets, ghostly signum, valor bonus for a day, a winner's standart bonus, a monster stone with a lifespan of 1 year, or a certificate for a unique bag.
You can purchase Lucky Tickets in unlimited quantities for gold coins in the Rarity Store.

In the Crystal Store, until August 31st, you will find barrels of denial. By using such a barrel, you can pause your experience gain from victories over brave warriors and Elinor monsters for a whole week.

We wish you generous gifts!

notes.title: Gifts from certificates
notes.content:
Glorious technomages! In the coming days, you will have the opportunity to obtain lucky tickets and certificates for gifts, which can be received by following the promotion’s terms.

Until the end of June 9th Elinor Bank gives the Certified Gifts. To get them you will need:
1. Make a one-time payment of at least 50 crystals to receive 30 Personalized Coins and one of five random certificates. Personalized Coins are awarded only with the first payment of the promotion.
2. Follow the conditions specified on the certificate to receive a gift and an additional certificate.
3. You can exchange a certificate for another one of the four types available by paying 30 Personalized Coins.
Completing the conditions of the event may grant you one of the following certificates: Cube of doubts, Chest of a famous technomage, Rich Man's Chest, Ghostly box, or Legendary jeweler's purse.

A certificate for the Ghostly box guarantees an additional personal card box with the first payment made with it. For subsequent payments, the personal card box is awarded randomly.

By defeating valiant opponents until June 11th inclusive, you have a chance to obtain lucky tickets among other trophies. Each ticket offers one of the following prizes: Gold Nuggets, Ghostly Signum, Valor Bonus for 24 hours, Winner's Standard Bonus, Monster Stone for 1 year, or Unique bag certificate.

An unlimited number of tickets can also be purchased at the Rarity Store for gold coins.

We wish you generous gifts!

notes.title: Malachite Beetles
notes.content:
The end of spring brings joy to Elinor with the invasion of malachite beetles, which dazzle all residents with their blinding glow and generously reward insect hunters!
Technomages of level 5 and above, wishing to collect components to obtain a malachite beetle, can do so. To craft a malachite beetle, you will need:
- 10 coils of gold wire, which can be obtained with a chance upon defeating an experienced monster;
- 10 golden beads, several of which can be obtained by defeating a valiant opponent;
- Semi-precious malachite, found among the rewards from bosses inhabiting dangerous territories;
- Master's clippers, purchased at the City Stores.
Charming beetles can be exchanged for rewards of your choice, and in addition, you have a chance to receive a rare inlay stone - Adamas of Power!

The Elinor Bank joins the hunt for these beautiful insects! For every 100 crystals from the amount of one payment, you will receive 4 malachite beetles as a gift!

You can collect parts, assemble, and obtain complete malachite beetles until the end of May 26th, and redeem desired rewards until the end of the adorable insects' lifespan.

Until May 24th inclusive, you can purchase barrels of denial at the Crystal Store, the activation of which will allow you to refrain from gaining experience when victorious in various battles.

Wishing you a wonderful mood!

notes.title: Preparing for the Spring and Labor Day Celebration
notes.content:
The weekend is still going strong, but despite that, the residents of Elinor have organized a big clean-up for the upcoming holiday and are awaiting your participation in the upcoming events! 
Visiting the headman Zlatovan or the elder Koragor, you can join in the gathering and giving away the brooms for the Great Cleanup throughout Longholm and Khatog. 
Then, pay a visit to the local farmers to participate in seedling cultivation and receive a pleasant reward for your efforts. 
Task completion is available until the end of May 3rd.

The city florists took care of the holiday in advance and added thematic gifts to their assortment. Don't pass by, purchase lovely gifts for yourself and your friends!

No holiday passes without technomagical promotions! Here's the schedule for the upcoming days:
- Until the end of today, you'll enjoy the Hunter Effect, which doubles the number of achievements triggered for monster kills.
- On April 30th, you'll have a chance to receive normal magic storages by defeating experienced monsters and valiant opponents.
- On May 1st, you will receive 2 water substances when you have enchanted vials from experienced monsters in dangerous territories.

Until April 30th inclusive, everyone interested can spin the wheel of fortune for a small fee and receive various prizes, including jubilee thalers.

By purchasing crystals until the end of May 1st, you'll receive a gift from the Elinor Bank — 30 Standards of Light for every 300 crystals from the amount of one payment! Standards of Light work outside the Dark Vaults, and each one, when victorious over a valiant opponent, will grant you a thread of fate. Getting a thread of fate corresponds to the respective achievement, and a chance to receive one point of Light reputation.

We wish you a great weekend!

notes.title: Technomage Competition and Observatory
notes.content:
The final week of the month is on the calendar, so the portal to the Observatory reopened in Elinor. Collectors can gather pouches of precious stones to earn more prize tokens for participating in the ranking!

Near the dwelling places of the Hermit-stargazer, a portal started shining. By stepping into it, you'll find yourself in the base camp of the Observatory, meaning it's time to head into battles in the snowy valley, where some changes await you:
- The invulnerability time upon entering the Observatory is reduced from 20 seconds to 5.
- This season, receiving rewards from the bosses Guardian of the Dawn Observatory and Guardian of the Sunset Observatory	becomes team-based. Trophies are received by each member of the winning team who has dealt at least 10% damage to the boss' health.
The distribution of trophies occurs as follows:
- Normal and golden lenses are received proportionally to the damage dealt.
- Each participant receives a Star Alchemist's bag and one of the types of rock samples. Each participant also has a chance to receive a scroll of enchantment and a jewelry box.
- The Observatory equipment chest is randomly awarded to one of the team members.

You can read more detailed rules of the Observatory on the infoportal. Participation in the rounds is available until 11:30 PM on April 28, and visiting the base camp, purchasing, and opening lens boxes is available until the end of May 1.
We highly value your opinion on the changes in the reward distribution for defeating the Guardians of Observatory and waiting for it on our forum.

The ranking "Technomagic competition" has not undergone any changes. You can familiarize yourself with the participation rules and ways to receive pouches with precious on the infoportal.
The results will be announced on April 29 at 5:30 AM during morning technical maintenance.

By purchasing crystals until the end of April 24, you will receive 2 violet pouches of precious stones as a gift for every 300 crystals of one payment size.

Wishing you a great mood!

notes.title: Maslenitsa has arrived!
notes.content:
It's time for crepes, pancakes, and cheesecakes! In Eleanor, the Maslenitsa week has come with the burning of the effigy and a prize pillar!

By visiting the city tavern, you can help distribute festive treats to the honored citizens of the city. In anticipation of spring, you can also burn the festive effigy and receive special ammunition as a reward, necessary for the new medal line "Farewell to winter." 
The quest completion is available until the end of March 17, and you can claim the reward for the burned effigy until March 18 inclusive.
Important! You can only claim the reward (Maslenitsa box) if you haven't received the boxes earlier as a reward for this quest.
From March 15 to 17 a festive pillar will appear near the Maslenitsa effigy. You will need to climb it for valuable gifts: one attempt every 12 hours and as many attempts as you want at any time for sun tokens, which you can find in the Crystal Store.
And, of course, the crepe ranking! 
Throughout the week, you will need to bake delicious crepes to receive sets of Maslenitsa ammunition for the "Farewell to winter" medals as a reward for prize places. You will also earn points in the "Race Participant" medals!
To bake crepes, you will need crepe mix and exotic fillings from Eleanor's monsters:
- Spider tenderloin from adult spiders, shadowhunters, and arachnids.
- Spooky mushrooms from ancient skeletons, zombies, miners, coalmen, and gravediggers.
Unusual ingredients need to be mixed with elixirs of strength or hardness to create a delicious crepe filling. You can purchase all the necessary ingredients for making crepes from the trader near the Colosseum.
You can taste the crepes in any battles until the end of March. A crepe with meat filling increases the character's base damage, while a crepe with mushroom filling increases the character's armor.
The ranking results will be announced on March 18 at 5:30.

Wishing you a delicious week and easy rewards!

notes.title: The Holiday of Charming Warriors
notes.content:
The entire Eleanor is eagerly awaiting the day of the charming inhabitants of the universe, but already today the festive events have begun: the Knight Tournament, "Flower Week," and other Technomagic celebrations! Every warrior dreams of dedicating their victories to a lady of his heart, and every lady aims to become the most charming. The best way to achieve this is to participate in the Knight's Tournament!
Upon entering the game, all potential knights will once receive a brooch for their beloved lady. This brooch should be presented to the chosen one with whom you wish to share your victories in the tournament, earning charm points for her.
By reciprocating, ladies can increase the amount of fame for their knight, and charm for themselves by gifting him one of the following items:
- Charming Lady's Handkerchief: doubles the knight's available battles in the current day in the tournament and allows them to gain +1 fame and charm with each victory for 30 minutes. Can be obtained with some chance from experienced monsters in dangerous territories.
- Charming Lady's Ribbon: increases the knight's available battles in the current day in the tournament by 5 and allows them to gain +3 fame and charm with each victory for 1 hour. Can be obtained with some chance from any suitable bosses.
- Charming Lady's Glove: increases the knight's available battles in the current day in the tournament by 20 and allows them to gain +6 fame and charm with each victory for 3 hours. Can be obtained with some chance by defeating opponents on the Island of Initiation and in the Colosseum.
Gifts for the knight of your heart can be found: handkerchief and ribbon for gold, and the knight's talisman for personalized coins in the Rarity Store; gloves are available in the Crystal Store.
Daily, upon entering the game, all warriors will receive 20 attempts for battles in the tournament. By using the knight's talisman, you can get an extra 12 attempts for battles in the tournament until midnight and gain +5 fame or charm with each victory for 2 hours. The knight's talisman is obtained with some chance by defeating valiant opponents on the Island of Initiation and in the Colosseum.
By winning the tournament, the knight will receive +1 to their fame for the "Most Glorious Knight" ranking, and the lady will receive +1 to her charm for the "Most Charming Lady" ranking, along with generous gifts ranging from a normal ink barrel to hearts of mines. Additionally, both will earn points to the personal "Fighter" ranking.
The ranking results will be announced on March 11 at 5:30.

No women's day is complete without flowers!
Collect bouquets of tulips, lilies of the valley, and snowdrops, delight beautiful ladies with them, and participate in the "Flower Week" ranking!
Tulip and lily of the valley bouquets grow on their own by purchasing tulip bulbs or lily of the valley seeds, a pot with magical soil, and a watering can with magical water from the trader near the Colosseum. Snowdrop bouquets are obtained by defeating any monsters in Eleanor and valiant opponents. For each collected bouquet, you will receive 1 point in the "Flower Week" ranking. The prize places will be taken into account in the "Race Participant" medal line. The results will be announced on March 11 at 5:30.

By visiting the Horsefly and Hilgor, you can help in preparing a gift for the beloved lady. Headman Zlatovan and Elder Koragor will tell you that the holiday is approaching and many things need to be done, while friend Martius is curious about the arrival of spring! It is up to you to figure all this out no later than the end of March 10.

Happy holiday to you, dear Eleanor ladies!

notes.title: Festive Season
notes.content:
Winter has arrived, and the snow with frost reminds us more than ever of the approaching New Year. While many areas of Eleanor enjoy warm sunshine all year round, all residents are eager to set up festive Christmas trees and decorate them in the best way possible to bring joy to themselves and the children.

To make a festive ikebana you’ll need to go in search of these attributes:
- Glass ball: Obtained from experienced monsters on the Snow Island or crafted using super glue from ball shards, which can be obtained from any monsters in Eleanor except initial locations.
- Magic Light: Earned by defeating valiant opponents. If your victory occurs in a winter territory, there is a chance to get 2 magic lights at once.
- Spruce sprigs: Found in trophies from bosses in dangerous territories of Eleanor. spruce sprigs can also be obtained for every 150 crystals spent. Read the details in the quest log.
- Ribbons and Pots: Used to collect decorated spruce sprigs, available for purchase until December 24 in the Crystal Store. Ribbons can also be found in the city store.
Eleanor's residents, level 5 and above, can collect holiday attributes until December 20 inclusive, and rewards for exchanging Christmas trees can be obtained until the end of their lifespan.

For exchanging Christmas trees, you can receive the following gifts:
- From a spruce sprig: 5 pieces of winter ammunition (normal giant Glace and crystals of taming) and 40 particles of eternal ice.

- From a small Christmas tree: A set of winter ammunition, 10 pieces of all kinds, 90 particles of eternal ice, and 5 summoning seals.

- From a beautiful Christmas tree: 15 pieces of winter ammunition, 140 particles of eternal ice, 10 summoning seals, 6 ghostly cards of Darkness and Light.

- From a lush Christmas tree: 20 pieces of winter ammunition, 200 particles of eternal ice, 15 summoning seals, 18 ghostly cards of Darkness and Light, and 1 set of boss summons.

- The most beautiful, royal Christmas tree, will gift you the most generous presents: 25 pieces of winter ammunition, 300 particles of eternal ice, 20 summoning seals, 30 ghostly cards of Darkness and Light, 2 sets of boss summons, and a December scroll of choice. It contains one of the selectable gifts: 4000 particles of eternal ice, 500 nimelin shards or rage stone, 12 ghostly boss cards, 32 ghostly magic cards, 10 fruitful leaves of the money tree. These gifts can be obtained as many times as you like. Additionally, this scroll can be exchanged once for 4000 prize tokens and 1000 fragments of fractal matrix (exchange is available to those who have access to the test chambers of the Dor-Taund temple). 5 such scrolls can be exchanged once for a certificate for an individual seal.

New decks of cards and jokers of schools and magic skills appeared in Technomagic, allowing you to temporarily weaken your opponent's spells. Cards from the decks of mages and knights are available to humans, and when the effect is applied from the joker of these decks, it weakens the power of spells for dwarves with engineer and warrior skills. Engineer and warrior jokers are available to dwarves and weaken the magic of spells for humans from the school of mages and knights. These cards are obtained with a chance when defeating a valiant opponent on the continent (Soli-Dor, Mines, Hive, Catacombs, Dungeons, the Snow Island).

Wishing you joyful tree decoration!

notes.title: Preparing for the beginning of Winter
notes.content:
The headman and the elder of Eleanor announced the preparation for winter and a mass gathering of fabrics, leather, and threads to make warm clothing for the city's residents!
Technomages of level 6 and above can participate in the event until the end of November 26. For delivering frosty garment, you will receive a random reward and progress points for the achievement "The Great Tailor," if the achievement has not been unlocked before.

To sew frosty garments, you will need:
- Special pattern: Sold by a merchant near the Coliseum.
- Tanned fur: Sometimes obtained when defeating bats, bloodsuckers, cavemen, rats, bears, vampires, Kobold, Vugluskr, and Hive goblins.
- Durable leather: There’s a chance to find it as a reward from monsters such as lizards, monitor lizards, dragons, worms, octopuses, Fish-Lizards, blind man, infected goblins, and gravediggers.
- Soft down: Rarely can be obtained from spirits, ghosts, goose, phantoms, Coliseum spirits, stellars, and luminaries.
- Spider silk: Can be found among the remains of arachnids like adult spiders, darkworms, and black arachnids.
- Fabric roll: Found among other resources when opening troll bags.
- Tailor's kit: You need to craft it using 2 iron ores, 10 linen threads, 2 needle sets, and a 
measuring tape obtained from a defeated valiant opponent. The measuring tape is also sold in the Crystal Store.

The Tournament of Equals awaits you again! After getting a special ticket, you need to sign up in the journal at the Academy Square. Once a worthy opponent is found, you will engage in a battle with equal characteristics and magic, where only Power Concentrates and gems can help you. Daily, you will receive 10 tickets upon entering the game until the tournament ends. Additional tickets, as well as ammunition for the tournament, can be purchased in the Rarity Store.
As a reward for winning the tournament, you will receive 1 point each in the "Fighter" and "Triumph" ratings and a chance to get a measuring tape.

For players of level 16 and above: Sh'aktayn is waiting for you on the Island of Initiation, ready to share more secrets of Light, allow strengthening the bracelet of Light to level 20, use magical, heroic, and epic Runes of Light and the Commander’s luminaries stones, as well as transform legendary pennants of Light into components.

The Bank of Eleanor is once again generous with gifts! Until November 19, for every 500 crystals purchased, you will immediately receive 10 boxes of Light and peaceful protectresses!

Get ready for winter in high spirits!

notes.title: Autumn Blues
The Tournament of Equals and Ether Purification
notes.content:
Valiant warriors! This weekend, you can expect several adventures at once! "Tournament of Equals" or "Ether Purification" - choose how you want to spend this technomagical weekend. Or perhaps, putting aside all the tasks, is it worth participating in both events?

The Tournament of Equals is a duel for true heroes! With a special ticket, you need to register your participation in the journal on the Academy Square, and as soon as a worthy opponent is found, a duel with equal characteristics and magic will begin, where only Power Concentrates and Gems can help you. You will receive 10 tickets daily upon entering the game until the end of the tournament. Additional tickets and ammunition for the tournament can be purchased in the Rarity store. 
As a reward for winning the tournament, you will receive 1 point in the "Fighter" and "Triumph" ratings, as well as a Fiber of light or a flap randomly. 
By placing 6 Fibers of light in an empty box, you will receive a Box of Light, and by sewing 3 flaps using a Magister's needle, you will get a peaceful protectress. 
The empty box, as well as the Rune of Power, which doubles the receiving of the Light Boxes, are sold in the Rarity store, and the Magister's needles are available at Urdin’s and Barfos' city store. 
Participation in the tournament is available until the end of Sunday, and you can collect fibers into boxes and sew flaps until September 25th.

Ether Purification is a task available from Valian or Chemicle. Visit the alchemy master of your faction and learn more about the ways to mine aquaionite, that is needed for the aether purification process:
- Small portions can be received daily from an alchemist or herbalist, or found in the Soli-Dor wells and exchanged for universal coins from the cryptographer;
- By purchasing retorts from the merchant near the Colosseum, you can mine aquaionite from skilled monsters of dangerous territories;
- Buy it in the Artifact Store.
Depending on the quality of the purified aether, you will receive different rewards, and it's up to you to decide at which stage of purification to stop. 
Receiving a reward for purified aether completes the task, but you can receive it again by purchasing a dark aether in the Rarity Store. 
Obtaining aquaionite (except for purchase) is only available until the end of September 26th, and you can purify the aether and receive a reward from it at any time convenient for you. 
A reminder: after receiving the reward from the aether, all methods of obtaining aquaionite, except for purchase, will be unavailable. We recommend claiming the reward at the end of the event.

We wish you a pleasant weekend!

notes.title: Realizing the secrets of the Light
notes.content:
Sh'aktain is waiting on the Island of Dedication for all those who wish to continue learning about the light side and receive new abilities of the Light!

The learning of the light path continues and new quests have become available in Elinor, where you will be able to transform normal, enchanted, and magical pennants of Light into components, as well as turn components back into pennants. You will be able to upgrade the Bracelet of Light to the Bracelet of Light Wisdom, which has a built-in rune of Light, you can purchase and study in the city library the recipe for a normal rune of Light for skill marks and the scheme of the candle of valor for darkness marks, as well as to insert the rune and the candle into equipment items. 
There are some restrictions that come into effect with the appearance and the reputation of Light:

- forbidden to wear a cloak of Darkness or a cloak with the rune of Darkness, when you are wearing a bracelet of Light, a bracelet with the rune of Light or the pennant of Light is active.
- forbidden to wear a bracelet of Light or a bracelet with the rune of Light, if you are wearing a cloak of Darkness, cloak with the rune of Darkness or active pennant of Darkness.
- forbidden to activate the pennant of Darkness, if you are wearing a bracelet of Light or a bracelet with the rune of Light
- forbidden to activate the pennant of Light, if you are wearing a cloak of Darkness or a cloak with the rune of Darkness. 
Further quests to improve your Bracelet of Light are expected next month. 

Have a good one!

notes.title: School is coming soon
The Observatory and the competition of technomages
notes.content:
21.08.2023
The Observatory and the competition of technomages
The summer is almost over, and new events have begun in the Elinor: "The Pearl Harvester" and " Competition of technomages" rankings, as well as the next season of the Observatory.

You will need to use the portal near the Hermit Stargazer's lodge. After you move to the base camp, redistribute your magic points to combat spells. After that, you can fight monsters and formidable opponents in the snowy lands to get normal and gold lenses, which you can use to purchase items in the Observatory store.

You can participate in the event season until 23:30 on August the 27th, and purchase lens boxes at the base camp until the end of August the 30th. 
You can read more about the Observatory rules on the infoportal portal. 
https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/Observatory/

Also, another summer ranking "Pearl Harvester" started today. By fulfilling the conditions specified in the ranking description, you will be able to get an obsidian award and points in the "Race participant" medal line.

Have a good one!

notes.title: Hot weekend
notes.content:
You glorious warriors! This coming weekend you'll find limited shipments of rare items in the Crystal store, a gift from the Bank of Elinor, and reports from the Expedition Commander and Knowledge Keeper! 

Until August 11, by completing daily quests of the commander in the Hive and the Knowledge Keeper, you will receive documents from them confirming the fact of completing the quests. 10 reports of one type are exchanged for a technowarrior's chest with rare ammunition. 
You can get the Commander's report for completing quests in the Hive (Exorcising many-legged, Exorcising Wings, Replenishing supplies, Destroying clutches, Following the trail of Grobfts, Eliminating competitors), and the Keeper's report for quests in the Temple of the Ancients (Measuring magfield and Extracting tags).

Limited quantities of rare items await you daily at 20:00 throughout the weekend on the Crystal store counters: 
28.07 - 3 cages per each faction with loyal bats and bloodsuckers
29.07 - 6 durable stones of bloody confrontation for the whole world
30.07 - 6 strong stones of devastating spoils for the whole world

Gift from the Bank of Elinor! For every 500 crystals of your payment amount by the end of July 30th you will receive 1 ghostly card, also for the first 500 crystals you guaranteed to receive a card box, and for all further 500 crystals of your payment amount you get a chance for additional card boxes.

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: The time of berries
notes.content:
Summer is the season of harvesting! Close to the middle of the season ripe berries, which can be used to make delicious jam or wonderful morsels. That is why it is time to put your swords and axes aside and, equipped with a special basket, go to pick ripe berries and exchange berry collections for gifts!
Until the end of July 27, you can get berries in the following ways:
- make products according to the weaver's recipes to obtain strawberries
- defeat valiant enemies in all Elinor territories except the Tower of Despair and Grimbold Fortress to get blueberries.
- open burglar's chests to get a chance to get cloudberries
- defeat evil bosses ( according to the conditions of getting a reward when you win) to find blackberries.
- win in fights on the territory of the Tower of Despair and the Grimbold Fortress to get gooseberries.

If you want to harvest as many berries as possible, you can purchase a permit from the Crystal store, which allows you to get a chance to harvest a random type of berry when defeating any monsters (except for the initial locations and bosses). 
Stacking different types of berries in baskets will earn you a certain reward (please note! the rewards have been changed), and for the total number of baskets that you collect, you will receive additional berry cups!

For 100 berry baskets, you will receive a 3rd place trophy, which will give you the opportunity to receive a choice of miner's tools once a day.
After harvesting 300 berry baskets, you will receive a 2nd place trophy and the opportunity to choose once a day one of the effects for 1 hour: negation, scroll of fortune, hunter or master.
And if you harvest 500 berry baskets, you will receive a 1st place trophy, which you can use once a day to receive concentrates of magic, concentrates of life or normal cubes of doubt or try your luck and get valuable prizes, including the main prize - Adamas of power and 5000 of personalized coins. 
When the event is over, the faction that has harvested the most delicious berries in their baskets will receive 10% more money when they win for 30 days!

The bank of the Elinor presents gifts! Up to July 18 inclusively for every 100 crystals from the amount of one payment you will receive 3 chests with berry collection!

You will find new items among the rewards in the Berry Season event: 
- Legendary jeweler's purse - can be received for a complete berry collection. The purse contains rare inlay stones of your choice.
- sealed symbol - can be obtained by "Trying the Fortune" of the Berry Cup for 1st place. With 100 ink of the matching color, you can get one of the damage, strength, and weakening symbols of your choice. 
- Blacksmith's sack - you can get the "Trying Fortune" of the Berry Cup for 1st place. Contains 1 piece of random blacksmith ore.

Have a great harvesting!

notes.title: Malachite beetles in Elinor
notes.content:
Rays of warm sunshine sparkle on the shells of malachite beetles, reminding us that spring is over and it's time to hunt the cute insects. 
Brave Elinorians of level 5 and higher can go on the hunt for items that gather in the malachite beetles. 
The adorable beetles are exchanged at your choice for valuable rewards. You have a chance to get a rare incrustation stone, the Adamas of power!
You can assemble the malachite beetles from these parts: 
- 10 coils of gold wire, is obtained with a chance when you defeat an experienced monster;
- 10 gold beads, you can get several pieces at once, when you defeat a valiant enemy;
- craftsmanship malachite is available among the rewards from the bosses that live in dangerous territories;
- the master cutters can be purchased in the city stores.

Elinor Bank is giving its depositors malachite beetles that have already been assembled! For every 100 crystals of payment amount, you'll get 4 beetles at once! 

You can get pieces, assemble and receive whole malachite beetles until the end of May 28. Exchanging beetles for desirable rewards is available until the cute insects' time of life expires.

Have a great mood and have fun!

notes.title: Water elemental spells
notes.content:
Brave warriors! Masters of the Order and the water guild are ready to accept their adepts and reveal the secrets of water elemental spells.
Humans can learn new spells of the water magic school from level 9. Dwarves can learn the skills of water magic. Masters Aquia and Agvator will share these spells with you.

You must have a personal grimoire to learn spells, which the Cryptographer will help you to make. If you already have a grimoire, the Cryptographer will tell you that you should put the grimoire together with a magician's fountain pen in the magic library. This will make it easy and simple to use, to write new spells into it and add to the magic belt.

Once the grimoire is in the magic library, the masters will share with you the details of learning water elemental spells. After that, those who previously studied ice spells will be able to use it in any area.
Attention: Now the ice spells you learned are only available in the Grimoire of elemental magic. Ice spells will also be studied only in the grimoire in the magic library.

One of the spells available to learn from the school of water magic is the "Blind Luck" spell, also available to water magic crystal owners. Therefore, sturdy crystals of water and fire magic can be exchanged at any time for the water substance that you need to learn water magic spells.

You'll also be able to purchase rare items until April 20: 
- In the Crystal store you will find cobalt pickaxes ( you can get a small amount in the trading store in exchange for universal coins) and the life-giving ichor. 
- You can buy artifact blanks and blue crystals in the Rarity store.

Enjoy a successful learning of your new spells!

notes.title: News of Elinor
notes.content:
New week has begun, and that means it's time to go on new quests and battle the fierce boss Caretaker, whose trophies have been changed.
All Elinorians of level 8 and higher are invited to sign contracts for covert assignments! You can see the available contracts on the notice board, which is located near the central city square. All contracts are one-time and available from different levels: 
[list]
[*] from level 8 you can get a contract from Kimihla or Valian.
[*] from level 9 you can take a contract from Melchor or Zales
[*] from level 10 you can take a contract from Dharon or Gordon.
[*] from level 12 you can take a contract from Nagor or Barfos. 
[/list]
All contracts are secret and disclosure of its purposes is forbidden!

Some changes have been made to the Caretaker boss.
You need a horn plate to get the phase transition generator, this resource is extracted from the monster named Bonehead .
Boss trophies are now shared between team members and the player who dealt the most damage. Each team member will receive trophies in accordance with the proportion of damage dealt: gold, all kinds of beads, normal signums of the Ancients, petrified gold tablets. Also, each player may receive a fullerite heart with a chance.  Each player who deals the most damage is guaranteed to receive a fullerite heart, epic purification elixirs, and with a chance one of the fortune scrolls.


We have added the ability to purchase fullerite frames for personalized coins or in exchange for fullerite hearts to the Supply center. 

[i]Have a productive week![/i]

notes.title: It is spring in Elinor
notes.content:
The first day of spring is on the calendar! Elinorian healer and alchemist have decided to celebrate the day by resuming lessons in ether purification. Those technomagicians who prefer valiant combat and successful hunting are rewarded with individual chests, while the young residents who don't want to grow older now have elixirs of negation. And it's all available until the end of the week!

When you visit Valian and Kimihla, you will learn how to purify the ether necessary for the undiscovered recipe for immortality, and therefore for each portion of the luminous substance you will be rewarded generously!

In purifying ether, aqua-ionite will be needed, which can be obtained:
[list]
[*] by small daily portions from the alchemist or healer, as well as by finding it in the Soli-Dor wells and exchanging it for universal coins from the cryptographer;
[*] If the retort is in the inventory from experienced monsters of dangerous territories. You can buy a retort from a merchant near the Colosseum;
[*] in unlimited quantities at the Artifact store.
[/list]
After purification, you can begin purifying the dark ether again by purchasing it at the Rarity store for personalized coins.

After purification, you can begin purifying the dark ether again by purchasing it in the Rarity store for personalized coins.

You can complete quests, get aqua-ionite, and purchase dark ether until the end of March 5, and you can receive a reward or continue your ether purification experiment at any time.

While fighting valiant warriors and creepy monsters you have a chance to get additional reward - regular or heroic personal chests! There is a limited number of chests from inexperienced monsters, and any number from experienced monsters. Also, there are unlimited quantities of heroic chests for sale in the Rarity store.

No special efforts are required to open a trophy and get the treasure! Normal personal chests can be opened with a simple click, but for a heroic chest, you need to spend some personalized coins to open it and then you'll have a chance to get a certificate to change your character level or get an individual seal!

The Crystal store is also stocked with enchanted elixirs of negation! This elixir will reduce your character's current experience by 100 units. Moreover, if you defeat valiant opponents, you can also get a normal elixir of negation, which will reduce your character's experience by 25 units.

[i]Congratulations on the spring![/i]

notes.title: Defender of Elinor's Day
notes.content:
Glorious Technomagicians! The Motherland Defender's Day is coming and the Elinor world is ready for festive quests, promotions, and other fun activities!
Ghaslan and Nadum are waiting for helpers to increase their equipment collection. They will ask you to go to the "Glorious combat traditions" quest.
After completing it, the next quest "Stolen relics" will become available, and its completion will unlock the "'Protector" achievement, a line of which is extended this year as well! 
You can purchase the attributes necessary to complete the quests from the merchants near the Colosseum. 
Hurry and complete your quests and earn the "Protector V" achievement before the end of the year on February 26.
As it happens, Sh'aktain, the servant of darkness, is thinking of freeing himself from the spell of the Dark Lord during the pre-holiday season and encourages everyone to participate in the "Saved souls" event! 
To participate in the liberation of souls, you must have shadow dust, which can be obtained three pieces daily for the duration of the event from Sh'aktain or in unlimited quantities from the merchant on the Island of initiation. Next, you will need to visit the Dark Vaults and take wins there, earning 1 to 5 souls for each win with the removal of shadow dust for each win. 
You can read more about the quest in your journal. You can free the imprisoned souls until the end of March 7, and receive your reward no later than the end of March 10.
But that's not all! Hilgor and Virkley have decided to get your attention by resuming their search for ancient mechanisms! Antiquities connoisseurs will offer you 1 of 5 randomly chosen quests, which you will be able to cancel with " Notes on the Ancients ", after which you will have access to the quest on common terms again. Also, for a charge, you can remove the quest timer, the cost of removal increases each time, but is reset at midnight.For completing quests you will receive Ancient tokens and Grimbold's coins, which you can spend in the Supply center on items that can be used to unlock various medals and achievements. The "Shadow Warrior" and " Servant of the Ancients" medal lines were recently updated, and you can purchase the " Memories of Heroes" item to unlock these.
The "Mechanisms of the Ancients" event quests are available until March 3, and the completion of the quests and purchase of items in the Supply center are available until the end of March 5.

The world of Elinor is decorated for the holidays!
The city florists are happy to offer gifts for brave defenders, including the clapper "Holiday Grenade"! You can see themed rocks on the field in the fights, and among the smiles are tanks and more!

There will be daily promotions throughout Elinor during the holidays:
[list]
[*] On February 23, everyone will be able to visit the "Landing" without an obsidian pay or an order to attack.
[*] On February 24, all day long, your armor will not lose strength when you are defeated.
[*] On February 25, all victories in the Dark Vaults with shadow dust will bring twice as many freed souls to the mission.
[*] February 26 all day you will not leave the effect of the master's potion, which gives double the points received in combat medals ( effect is issued at logging into the game, summed with other similar effects).
[/list]
More gifts from Elinor Bank! If you purchase crystals before the end of February 26, for every 300 units of the amount of one payment you will receive one chest of the ancients, which contains items to simplify the completion of the quest "Mechanisms of the Ancients"!

And finally about the new thing! Technomagic world has an opportunity to get and strengthen the images of the "Black Knight" and "Bounty Hunter"! 
You can get the image only after reaching level 9 and in exchange for a complete set of similar armor and weapons from the Hermit stargazer, or buy gold lenses of the Observatory in his store. When you exchange the sets of  runes and stones in the items will be removed with no return! 
By strengthening your image with the gold lenses of the Observatory, you will increase your "Armor" and "Base Damage" characteristics!

[i]Congratulations to you, Defenders![/i]

notes.title: It's Maslenitsa!
notes.content:
Maslenitsa is a time of celebration for cooking! A whole week of cooking crepes with different toppings, and at the end of the celebration - mass scarecrow burning and climbing the pillar for prizes! 
Maslenitsa beginning always heralds a tasty ranking! You'll have to get involved in making crepes, and the most eager cooks will be rewarded with a keg or flasks of denial! 
You'll need mix and toppings to bake the crepes, which are sourced from the monsters in all of the lands in Elinor:
- spider cuttings from adult spiders, dark spider, and arachnids, 
- creepy mushrooms from ancient skeletons, zombies, miners, coal miners and gravediggers.
Obtained ingredients need to be mixed with elixirs of strength or hardness and the crepe topping is ready! 
All ingredients for making crepes are also sold by the Merchant near the Colosseum.
By eating the crepe with a meat topping you will increase the base damage, and with a mushroom topping you will increase your character's armor.
Anyone wishing to receive the Maslenitsa box will have to build and burn a scarecrow themselves in anticipation of spring, the base for a scarecrow being located near Dylan's farm and at the Khatog gate in the Quartz valley! 
You will need: 
[list]
[*] straw is contained in the rewards from monsters of all Elinor;
[*] fabric scraps can be obtained by defeating skilled bosses and valiant enemies;
[*] colored strips can be purchased from merchant near the Colosseum;
[*] fuel is made from various elixirs. Canisters are sold by the Colosseum merchant;
[*] matches are obtained from monsters of the underground places of Elinor. 
[/list]
When you have collected everything you need, you can go to the end of the ritual!
From February the 24th, near the Maslenitsa Scarecrow stand you will find a pillar, if you climb it you can get one of the prizes: a box with jewelry and 50 ancient tokens, holiday gifts in character info, glittering shards, gladiator coins, crepes, fortune token, combat boots, fruit leaf of money tree, 500 crystals pouch. 
You may try your luck every 12 hours or whenever you have a sun token from the crystal store, which is required for each try.
You are always very welcome in the city taverns and they want to ask for your help in delivering the festive meal to the honorable townsfolk. 

[i]Happy Maslenitsa![/i]

notes.title: New Year attributes collection
notes.content:
New Year is on its way! And after decorating the fluffy Christmas tree, you should be sure to prepare holiday attributes that will complete your holiday decorations and give you great gifts!

The New Year's collection consists of 5 holiday attributes:

You can assemble various collections from the holiday attributes of different sizes. Get special prizes for each of them!

notes.title: Approaching the New Year
notes.content:
With the onset of winter, we begin to feel the approach of the time of magic, gifts and, of course, a beautifully decorated Christmas tree. All of us, and not only children, but also adults, are looking forward to the New Year. So let's not delay and start decorating fluffy Christmas trees right now!

To create beautiful Christmas trees, you need to get festive attributes:

[*] The glass ball is in reward from the experienced monsters of the Snow Island. Also, you can collect the fragments of the ball in reward from all the monsters of Elinor, except for the initial locations, and glue them together with superglue into a whole ball.
[*] The magic light is obtained when defeating valiant opponents. If you defeat your opponent in the winter territory, you have a chance to get 2 magic lights at once.
[*] Fir twigs will be found among the trophies of the bosses of Elinor dangerous territories. You will also receive twigs for every 150 crystals spent. Read the details in the task log.

notes.title: Black Friday continues
Technomage Contest and Observatory
notes.content:
Brave warriors! New week has begun and we are glad to tell you that the new season of the Observatory and the ranking week of the Technomagic Contest has started!
The portal to the Observatory shines again near the home of the Hermit Stargazer, where battles with fierce monsters, duels with rival teams and intriguing battles for the possession of the Sphere await you. More information about the Observatory rules you can find [url=https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/Observatory/]here[/url]. 
Among the items in the Hermit's store you will find several new items:
[list]
[*] Qualitative ArZebirmite, a unique inlay stone in the "Helmet" item slot of the outfit.
[*] Cage with bats or bloodsuckers with a 2 week lifetime. You can purchase this item no more than once per month. 
[/list]
As a reminder, the fighting season lasts until 11:30 PM on November 27, and you can visit the base camp, purchase and open lens boxes until November 30 including.
The technomagic competition consists of obtaining pouches of colored gemstones and combining these into a collection.
The pouches can be obtained in the following ways:
[olist]
[*] Gray pouches in secret chests scattered around the world. The location of the chests changes at midnight regardless of your process. If you've managed to find all the chests for the current day and wish to continue your search, you must purchase a special card from the crystal store.
[*] Green pouches are available from the bosses of safe territories (Quartz Valley, Shion Forest, Wild Islands, etc.).
[*] Blue pouches are in trophies from mad warriors, and orange pouches you get with the reward for defeating bosses of dangerous lands. 
[*] Red pouches drop with a chance when you open C.H.E.S.T.s. 
[/olist]
You can read more about the Technomagic Contest [url=https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/rating/stone_rep/]here[/url]. 
Gathering collections of gems you will be rewarded with: a gladiator coin and points into the Technomagic Contest ranking (does not count towards the "Participant of the Race" medal). At the time of summing up the ranking, you will be rewarded with prize tokens, and you can buy rare items in the Supply Center.
The list of rewards that you get from C.H.E.S.T. has been changed. You will randomly get one of the prizes: 5 crystals of hatred or 1 elixir of purification regardless of your level, 9 weak hero spirits, 100 harpies from the chest, 3 regular cubes of doubts, 2 ghostly crystals, a crystal small key. 
When you open a purple C.H.E.S.T. you will be rewarded with 1000 personalized coins and one random prize: a cage with mice or bloodsuckers, a techno-warrior chest or one of two incrustation stones - a guidirit in armor and an arAlgid in earrings.
Note! Stones make items non-transferable, but are handed out transferable until the first use.

Elinor Bank is presenting you a gift! Till the end of November 22 you'll get 2 purple pouches with gems for every 300 crystals purchased per payment. 

[i]We wish you a productive week![/i]
