notes.title: Healing from the autumn blues
notes.content:
The golden leaves that fall from the trees of Elinor make me melancholy. It won't be long before the citizens begin to prepare their warm clothes. In the meantime, together with Laura and Miella, we will try to get rid of autumn melancholy and return the good vibes with bottles of sunshine and generous gifts! 

[b]Throughout the 10 days, you are allowed to join in the collection of gifts for the adorable cuties responsible for lost knowledge. You have 4 hours and a list of special items that adorable cuties would like to receive this autumn to complete one gift set[/b]. You can put no more than 10 items in one gift set. The total amount of sentiment must be 100 points or higher. 

Laura and Miella's gift set may include the following items:
[olist]
[*] "'Summer mix" cocktail provides 1 point, purchasing it for universal coins from a merchant near the Colosseum.
[*] Seashell - 3 points, can be found on the coast of Soli-Dor.
[*] Glace coffee - 5 points, with a chance to get it when you open the box of Wisemen.
[*] Volleyball - 9 points, you get by defeating valiant opponents.
[*] Tropical Fruit - 30 points, can be obtained from the Certificate of fortune, C.H.E.S.T. and Golden chest. 
[/olist]

For every gift set, the girls will gift you back with a happy autumn chest, containing gifts such as: 
[list]
[*] 2-4 vials of sunbeam;
[*] 5 personalized coins;
[*] 5 celestial pearls;
[*] 5 regular magic storages;
[*] 20 sunnies. 
[/list]
By collecting vials with a sunbeam, you will get an additional reward at your choice:
[list]
[*] for 10 vials - 2 star modifiers or a magic guiding lamp;
[*] For 20 vials - 2 Autumn pockets, 5 chests of techno-warrior, or an epic rasp;
[*] for 50 vials - 3 leader chests, an epic files or 4 fragile cornucopia;
[*] for 100 vials - 10 enchanted ink barrels, 1000 golden seeds, or 4 Spirit of the Hero;
[*] 200 vials - 2 scrolls of antavent improvement;
[*] 400 vials - stone Antavent in a bracelet. 
[/list]

You can reset the time allotted to complete one set and go to collect a new gift by removing the sandglass.
And you can start improving the mood after an introductory talk with Terrus or Terragor, provided that your character is at least level 5. 

[b]You can complete your gift sets by the end of November 20th[/b], and exchange the bottles for rewards and get nice little things from the autumn chest until the end of the month. 

[i]We wish you a sunny mood![/i]

notes.title: Eleanor Unity
notes.content:
While the final preparations for the holiday are underway, there are already promotions, discounts, and good cheer waiting for you in the world of Elinor!


City florists give you a good mood. You can buy themed holiday gifts from them.

Caring about your spirits, the headman and the elder of the town have prepared a [b]daily gift for you until the end of november 6th[/b]. You can receive the 2 hours of Negation effect until November 6th . You may receive this gift if you do not have another similar effect (that changes the experience you receive).


Another series of daily assignments from the "Calligraphy symbols" event awaits you until the end of November 6th. You can get normal ink and ink barrels for completing the quests, which are used to draw the characters.



Game promotions will give you some fun too!

[b]November 3rd[/b] - you will not lose your armor when defeating an opponent in dangerous territories.

[b]November 4th[/b] - when defeating an opponent of a hostile faction you will receive one gold or several silver Halloween coins, and destroying experienced monsters the coins will drop with a chance.

[b]November 5th[/b] - defeating equal opponents in the Dark vaults will allow you to release twice as many imprisoned souls with a single shadow dust.

[b]November 6th[/b] - you will have a chance to get signums without using the time seal, in battles against valiant opponents and experienced monsters.


You'll also enjoy discounts valid through the end of November 6th!

[list]
[*]50% on bundles of wood and bags of ingredients at the Crystal store.
[*]40% on recasting (changing characteristics) and changing the aura of clan and individual items.
[/list]
We wish you a good mood!

notes.title: Halloween in Elinor!
notes.content:
[b]Brave technomagicians! Are you ready for scary adventures and the important choice of "Candy or Life''? Then it's time to head out to meet the Scarecrow in Ghostly Elinor! [/b]

Even scary holidays need to start with preparation and decorating! Visit the town headman and elder for the "Halloween Gift" quest and get the opportunity to change the skin of a forge or repair workshop building to a Halloween skin at any time. And for those who don't want to do this quest, the purchase of a Halloween building makeover from the Halloween store is available. 

Brave warriors who are not afraid to cope with the difficulties of completing the "Very Strange Cases" and "Grim Mysteries of the Past" are waiting for a new and no less exciting quest "Breaking the Shackles". The quest is available to players of level 5 and higher from the Scarecrow. 

You can also grow a huge ripe pumpkin with gifts, and the Headless Warrior or the Headless Knight will tell you about the right way to grow it. 
Complete daily quests to get the pumpkin ammo you need to achieve the "Pumpkin Mayhem" achievement! 

Note: As a reward for this achievement, the Pumpkin medallion has been replaced by a new skin item, which you can upgrade with a gold seed and increase your characteristics. Upgrading the skin will give human characters a bonus to the "Fortitude" characteristic, and dwarven characters a bonus to the " Evil eye" characteristic. 
Previously obtained Pumpkin medallion is exchanged for this skin in the Halloween store. 

Besides completing a variety of quests in Ghostly Elinor, you'll learn how to grow ripe apples and be rewarded with silver and gold Halloween coins. 
Ingredients for making festive sweets are obtained depending on the level:
[list]
[*] skeleton ghost gives rewards to players of levels 5-10
[*] walking dead gives players of levels 11-15
[*] dark guard - for players of levels 16-20
[*] soul killer - for players of level 21+
[/list]
Silver Halloween coins can be exchanged for gold coins at a rate of 100 to 1, and gold coins can be spent in the Halloween store before the event is over. 
Among the new items you'll find: decorations for the town forge or workshop, a certificate to change the appearance of your personal Halloween outfit, gold seeds needed to enhance your pumpkin skin, and more. 
Making festive actions during the week you will take part in the rating, the reward for high places - reward tokens. The ranking includes growing a pumpkin and receiving gifts from it, creating and receiving rewards from the sweetest apples, producing apple seeds in the cauldron, victories in the ghostly Coliseum over opponents of an enemy faction and other theme actions in the territory of Ghostly Elinor. 

Note that participation in the ranking does not count towards the "Participant in the race" medal line. 
The results of the ranking will be summarized on November 2 at 8:00. 
[b]Completion of holiday quests is available until the end of November 4. [/b]
You can use the candy you've created, exchange Halloween silver coins and spend gold ones in the Halloween store no later than the end of November 6. 

Of course, you'll also find themed gifts at the town florists.


[b]The Elinor Bank is joining in the celebration: until October 30 inclusive[/b], it is presenting its depositors with the ripest apples! 
For each 500 crystals of the amount of one payment you get the 10 biggest, ripe apples, with 30 gold Helloween coins inside! 
Have a scary but fun holiday!

notes.title: Autumn leaf fall
notes.content:
Autumn is in full swing and there are two weeks of beautiful fall foliage, herbarium collection and exchange for autumn coins! 
You can find out about the fall collection from Iria and Ungor, as before. They will be glad to tell elinorians of level 6 and higher about all the details of collecting and sticking beautiful leaves in a notebook or a diary for a herbarium and exchange it for autumn coins to purchase rare items in the Autumn store. 
Briefly remind you of the ways to get leaves - when defeating experienced monsters and/or valiant opponents:
[list]
[*] oak - in Soli-Dor, catacombs, dungeons and mines beneath it;
[*] birch trees - on the Dedication Island;
[*] rowan - in the Hive and the Temple of the Ancients;
[*] willow trees - in safe territory.
[/list]
Maple leaves are in chests, which Iria and Ungor will tell you the location of once a day. If you decide to repeat the Maple Leaf gathering, you can update the location of the chests on the world map for 100 personalized coins, which the friendly autumn event coordinators will be more than happy to tell you. 
Herbarium notebooks can be received by completing a daily quest, but remember - at midnight the progress of the quest will be reset, and a new assignment will be given when you sign in to the game. Herbarium albums are sold in the crystal store. 
Sticking a collection of leaves in a notebook will give you 5 autumn coins, and sticking a collection of leaves in an album will give you 10 autumn coins. 
There are some new items among the regulars in the Autumn store this year as well:
[olist]
[*] Barrels with elixirs of purification of different levels; 
[*] pouch with fragments of the accuracy platums and its exchange for a higher level color; 
[*] visor of silence and sorrow; 
[*] crystal compounds needed to enhance class characters; 
[*] boxes of simple and valor earrings. 
[/olist]
